requirements.text: Delays between attempts start at base_delay and double each time, capped at max_delay (with a base of 0.5s: 0.5, 1, 2, 4)
requirements.quote: Delays between attempts start at `base_delay` and double each time, capped at `max_delay` (with a base of 0.5s: 0.5, 1, 2, 4)

requirements.text: Only status 429 and the gateway errors 502, 503 and 504 are retried; any other status is raised on the first failure
requirements.quote: Only status 429 and the gateway errors 502, 503 and 504 are retried; any other status is raised on the first failure

requirements.text: When the last attempt fails, raise RetryExhausted with the number of attempts and the last HTTP error as its cause

requirements.text: Each retry logs a warning such as retry 2/4 in 0.5s (next attempt, max attempts, delay)
